ressources.breathingDesc: 4-7-8 technique to calm anxiety in a few minutes.

exerciseList.title: Body scan
exerciseList.desc: Mentally scan each part of your body to release tension.
steps: Lie down or sit comfortably, eyes closed.
Bring attention to your feet. Feel them, release all tension.
Slowly move up: ankles, calves, knees, thighs.
Continue to belly, chest, shoulders.
Finish with neck, face, top of head.

exerciseList.title: 5-4-3-2-1 Grounding
exerciseList.desc: Return to the present moment by engaging your 5 senses to calm anxiety.
steps: Name 5 things you see around you.
Name 4 things you can touch. Touch them.
Name 3 sounds you hear right now.
Name 2 smells you notice (or like).
Name 1 thing you can taste.
Breathe slowly. You are here, safe.

exerciseList.title: Muscle relaxation
exerciseList.desc: Tense and release each muscle group to free physical stress.
steps: Clench fists hard for 5 seconds, then release.
Tense arms and shoulders 5 seconds, then release.
Scrunch face hard 5 seconds, then release.
Tense belly 5 seconds, then release.
Tense legs and feet 5 seconds, then release.
Stay still 1 minute and observe the relaxation in your whole body.

exerciseList.title: Peaceful visualization
exerciseList.desc: Imagine a safe, calm place to reduce stress and find serenity.
steps: Close eyes and breathe slowly three times.
Imagine a place where you feel safe: beach, forest, room.
Observe the details: colors, sounds, smells of this place.
Feel the warmth or coolness of the air on your skin.
Stay in this place as long as you wish.
Return gently by wiggling fingers, then open eyes.

articleList.title: Understanding depression
articleList.desc: Symptoms, causes and first steps toward well-being.
articleList.content:
Depression is much more than a passing sadness. It's a mood disorder that affects how you feel, think, and handle daily activities.

**Common symptoms**
Persistent sadness, loss of interest in usual activities, fatigue, sleep disturbances, difficulty concentrating, feelings of guilt or worthlessness.

**Possible causes**
Biological factors (chemical imbalance in the brain), difficult life events (grief, separation, unemployment), family history, chronic illness.

**First steps**
Talk to someone you trust. Consult a doctor or mental health professional. Maintain a daily routine, even minimal. Avoid isolation.

articleList.title: Managing daily anxiety
articleList.desc: Simple techniques to reduce stress and find calm.
articleList.content:
Anxiety is a natural reaction to stress, but when it becomes excessive, it can disrupt your daily life.

**Recognizing anxiety**
Palpitations, muscle tension, intrusive thoughts, avoidance of certain situations, irritability.

**Effective techniques**
Deep breathing (4-7-8 technique), mindfulness meditation, regular physical exercise, limiting caffeine and screens in the evening.

**When to consult**
If anxiety lasts more than 6 months, interferes with your work or relationships, or is accompanied by panic attacks, consult a professional.

articleList.title: Recognizing a toxic relationship
articleList.desc: Signs of emotional control and how to break free.
articleList.content:
A toxic relationship can be hard to identify from the inside, especially when you love the person involved.

**Warning signs**
You feel constantly criticized or devalued. You walk on eggshells. You isolate from your loved ones. You fear the other's reactions.

**Emotional control**
Manipulation, excessive jealousy, control of outings and acquaintances are forms of psychological violence.

**Breaking free**
Talk to a trusted friend or professional. Set clear boundaries. Know that you deserve a respectful relationship.

articleList.title: Building self-esteem
articleList.desc: Practical exercises to regain confidence in yourself.
articleList.content:
Self-esteem is the value you give yourself. It builds and strengthens over time and with practice.

**Daily exercises**
Write down 3 positive things you did or felt each evening. Replace automatic negative thoughts with neutral or kind formulations.

**Setting small goals**
Every goal achieved, even a tiny one, builds confidence. Start with simple actions and gradually increase.

**Circle**
Distance yourself from people who devalue you. Surround yourself with people who support and encourage you.

articleList.title: Sleep and mental health
articleList.desc: Why sleeping well is essential for your psychological balance.
articleList.content:
Sleep is a fundamental pillar of mental health. Chronic lack of sleep increases the risk of depression and anxiety.

**Sleep hygiene**
Go to bed and wake up at fixed times. Avoid screens 1h before sleep. Keep your bedroom cool and dark. Avoid caffeine after 2pm.

**Soothing rituals**
A herbal tea, light reading, a few minutes of deep breathing or meditation can signal your brain it's time to sleep.

**When to consult**
If you sleep less than 6h per night for more than 3 weeks, or if you wake up exhausted despite a full night, talk to a doctor.

articleList.title: Talking about your suffering
articleList.desc: How to break the silence and ask for help without shame.
articleList.content:
Talking about what you feel is often the hardest first step, yet the most liberating.

**Why silence is heavy**
Keeping your suffering to yourself amplifies it. Isolation reinforces negative thoughts and prevents finding solutions.

**How to start**
Choose a trusted person. Start with a simple phrase: 'I'm not doing well right now.' You don't have to explain everything at once.

**If you have no one**
Mythenena's AI assistant is available 24/7, without judgment. Forums also allow sharing anonymously with people who understand.

confidentialite.title: Privacy Policy
confidentialite.intro: Last updated: September 2026. Mythenena is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights.
confidentialite.importantContent: Mythenena is a listening and information tool, not a medical service. In case of emergency, contact emergency services (+261 20 22 XXX XX) or go to the nearest emergency room.

dataProtection.title: Data Protection
dataProtection.content: We only collect strictly necessary data: display name, email/phone (for login), and your assessment responses (anonymized). No sensitive data is stored without your explicit consent.

anonymity.title: Guaranteed Anonymity
anonymity.content: On the forum, AI chat, and support groups, you are identified only by a pseudonym. Your real identity is never visible to other users. Directory professionals only see what you choose to share when requesting an appointment.

dataUsage.title: Data Usage
dataUsage.content: Your data is used only to: authenticate you, personalize your experience, improve our services (anonymous statistics), and contact you if you request it (appointments). We never sell your data.

sharing.title: Third-Party Sharing
sharing.content: No commercial sharing. Only cases: 1) You request an appointment (sent to chosen professional), 2) Legal obligation (imminent danger reporting), 3) Technical providers (hosting, AI) under strict confidentiality agreements.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: Per GDPR and Malagasy law: right of access, rectification, erasure, portability, restriction, objection. To exercise rights: contact us via the Privacy page. Account deletion available in settings (coming soon).

limits.title: Limits of Liability
limits.content: Mythenena is not an emergency medical service. AI can make mistakes. Support groups are moderated but not monitored 24/7. In crisis, contact emergency services immediately.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: For any questions about your data: confidentialite@mythenena.mg or via contact form. Data Protection Officer: DPO Mythenena.

faq.q1: How do I get started with Mythenena?
faq.a1: Simple: no signup required to start. Click "Start Assessment" on the homepage, answer 5 questions, and discover personalized resources. You can create an account later to save your history.
faq.a2: Yes, assessment, forum, AI chat, breathing exercises, and directory are 100% free. Premium offers (Essential Follow-up at 115,000 Ar/month and Intensive Follow-up at 207,000 Ar/month) add professional sessions.
faq.a3: Absolutely. We use TLS encryption, store only the minimum necessary, and never sell your data. See our Privacy Policy for all details.
faq.q4: Can I use Mythenena without creating an account?
faq.a4: Yes! All core features (assessment, anonymous forum, AI chat, exercises, directory) work without an account. The account only syncs your history across devices.
faq.q5: What is the Personal Assessment for?
faq.a5: It's a 5-question exploratory check (mood, sleep, stress, relationships, motivation) giving you a visual snapshot of your well-being and guiding you to appropriate resources. Not a medical diagnosis.
faq.a6: As many times as you want. Each assessment is dated, track your progress in "My Summary" (Synthesis page).
faq.q7: What if my score is low?
faq.a7: A low score indicates distress. The app automatically suggests: breathing exercises, AI chat, forum, or booking a professional. In emergency, call +261 20 22 XXX XX.
faq.q8: How do I join a support group?
faq.a8: Go to "Support Forum", choose a group (Depression, Self-Esteem, Sobriety), click it. You enter the anonymous group chat directly. ~15 participants per group.
faq.a9: Yes, by a moderation team and automated filters. But not 24/7 monitoring. Report concerning content. In crisis, contact emergency services.
faq.q10: Can I create my own group?
faq.a10: "Create New Group" feature coming soon. For now, the 3 main groups cover the most common needs.
faq.q11: Does the AI assistant replace a psychologist?
faq.a11: No. It's a 24/7 listening and guidance tool. It detects crisis signs and directs you to emergency services or professionals. It does not diagnose.
faq.a12: Yes, they are encrypted and anonymized. Not read by humans except for imminent danger reports (legal duty to protect).
faq.a13: Yes! The assistant understands and responds in French, Malagasy, and English. Change language in the menu (globe icon top right).
faq.q14: What does Essential Follow-up (115,000 Ar/month) include?
faq.a14: Everything free + 1 weekly 2-hour session with a verified listening professional (psychologist/psychiatrist), personalized confidential follow-up, cancelable anytime.
faq.q15: How do I book an appointment with a professional?
faq.a15: From the "Directory" tab or after choosing a Premium offer, click "Book Appointment", indicate availability and reason. The professional contacts you via the platform.
faq.q16: How do I delete my account?
faq.a16: Account deletion coming soon in settings. Meanwhile, contact us via Privacy page to request deletion (processed within 30 days).
faq.q17: I forgot my password, what now?
faq.a17: On the Login page, click "Forgot Password" (coming soon). You'll receive a reset link by email or SMS based on your identifier.
faq.a18: Yes, from your account settings (gear icon top right > Login > edit).
